name: Grilled salmon
summary: Cá hồi nướng is grilled Thác Bạc salmon, served on the town grills and at the restaurant by the Silver Waterfall gate. The flesh is firm and tight, rich and sweet.
origin: Thác Bạc, from the salmon farm at the foot of Silver Waterfall.
taste: Firm, tight flesh that eats rich and sweet.
howToEat: Order it hot from the grill on a cold evening, or as one course of a salmon meal by the falls.
where: The grill stalls at hồ Sa Pa and on the road down to the market, and Nhà hàng thác Bạc near the falls gate. Cá Hồi Vua on Lê Văn Tám also serves it.
seoTitle: Grilled salmon in Sapa — Thac Bac fish, firm and sweet
seoDescription: Cá hồi nướng on the Sa Pa grills and at the Silver Waterfall restaurant. Firm, tight flesh that eats rich and sweet.
